# Event Booking App

## Summary
A club's front office in one card — membership tiers, loyalty points,
fixture ticketing, match-day check-in and post-match surveys. Realized as
the App 4 stage-2 POC at `club-membership/club-membership.gts`; it exists
to prove the loyalty + event/booking clusters compose, and everything on
screen is a consumed block.

## Composition
- **Cards**: Member extends Loyalty Account (own ladder via `loyaltyTierField`); Match extends Event (opponent/home-away/competition/ticketsSold); Booking, Contact, Location, Survey consumed unchanged
- **Components**: Loyalty Dashboard (member home), Booking Calendar (fixtures with live availability)
- **Commands**: its RecordAttendance composes Check In Booking + Credit Points and owns the club arithmetic (50 home / 150 away × tier multiplier); Confirm Booking wired to un-confirmed bookings
- **Theming**: club identity enters via tokens only — the tier metals are `--tier-<slug>-bg/-fg/-ring` values the Tier Badge consumes; no block internals overridden

## Example
The linked Northbridge FC instance runs on a seeded world of members,
fixtures (all three availability states), bookings and a match-day survey.

## Non-goals
Payment processing, QR hardware, mobile wallets and virtual queues are
integrations the real product would add; here payment is a status and the
turnstile is a button, which is exactly enough to prove the blocks.
Season tickets (Subscriber/Subscription) and a rewards catalog are the
spec'd v1.1 features — the blocks exist; the app hasn't mounted them yet.
